_readme: Knowledge pages built by hand rather than as articles in WordPress (a page with
a table, photos or a form of its own). tools/build-articles.py gives each one a
card on /knowledge/, in its category (a category slug from data/articles.json),
among the articles of that category by date. The page itself is
knowledge/<slug>/index.html and is never generated or deleted by the build.
"product_category": the catalogue cards of that product category link their category line to the page.

pages.card_text: מה ההבדל בין שלוש המהדורות, איך מדביקים שלב אחר שלב, ומה חשוב לדעת לפני השימוש.
